note: call_cap.default = safety cap on gateway calls when no plugin and no --cap gives one (measured on our benches: 60 calls). review_title_threshold = token overlap above which a title is treated as a forbidden review. code_intervals = minimum seconds between two calls to the same host for the code engines.

verifier.note: One call per card; above max_chars_per_call (characters of sources), one call per source. A threshold to measure, not a fixed reference value. model: per host profile; an alias (opus, sonnet) follows the vendor's latest model, '' = the host CLI's own default; measured on 2026-10-26 with claude-opus-5-5; VP_MODEL or --model override it.

claude.note: Claude Code host: the prompt goes on stdin; the caller adds --allowedTools / --disallowedTools; cwd = work dir; env without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.

openai.note: Codex CLI host: the prompt goes on stdin ('-'), read-only sandbox, web search disabled; cwd = work dir.

contradictor.note: Optional contradictor after the report (tools/contradictor.py). families: empty = option absent; set it here, or VP_CONTRADICTORS, or ~/.config/vp/contradictors. A family is <via>[:<model>]: openai[:<model>] = the Codex CLI (openai host profile), claude[:<model>] = claude -p (claude host profile), <provider>:<model> = an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API named in providers (url, key = name of the key variable resolved as in KEYS.md or null for no key, extra = fields merged into the request body); add your own provider here or in VP_CONTRADICTOR_PROVIDERS (JSON). No model name is fixed in the code or here: the model id is given in the family (required for an API; for a CLI, empty = the CLI's own default model, so the choice follows the vendor); the models measured on 2026-10-27 are recorded in CHANGELOG.md and plugins/code.md. request = body fields of the measure (temperature 0, 8,000 output tokens). y_cap_chars = the cut of Y used in the measure. max_usd = ceiling on the match call and the rereads (host model) per run, checked before each call with reread_usd_per_call as the estimate; a CLI on a subscription (openai profile) reports 0, so the ceiling only bites on metered hosts; reread_model per host profile: empty = the host CLI's default model (--model / VP_MODEL override it).
